notes: Version: final MT1 (v2.x incl. The Last Divinity DLC: Wurmkin clan, 5 clan rares, 5 Concealed Caverns cards, unit Essences). Source = wiki Lua data module Module:Cards/Data (descriptions, stats, tags) + champion pages (==Upgrades== tables). type: Champion / Unit / Spell / Blight / Scourge / ChampionUpgrade; the wiki's unit tribe (Imp, Demon, Morsel, Wickless...) is extra.subtype. MT1 cards have no printed upgraded version (upgrades are stones/Dark Forge), so cost_upgraded/text_upgraded are null; multi-stage cards (Blazing Bolts, Spikedriver Colony) keep each stage in text separated by ' / '. 'x×X' = per Ember spent on an X-cost card. extra.essence = The Last Divinity unit Essence (bonus a unit grants when merged into another at the Divine Temple). extra.wiki_tags = the wiki editors' tag list (partly subjective: Create, Draw, Ember, Move...). ChampionUpgrade entries: 12 champions x 3 paths x 3 tiers; attack_delta/health_delta = stat bonus over the champion's base card at that tier (wiki values are cumulative per tier). Variable cards (Olde Magic, Nexus Spike, For the Greater Good) carry a summary in extra.variable. No removed/unused cards are present in the data module. Completeness: per-clan scraped vs wiki 'Category:<Clan> Cards': Hellhorned 41/41; Awoken 41/41; Stygian Guard 41/41; Umbra 47/47; Melting Remnant 41/41; Wurmkin 43/43; Clanless 28/28 | total scraped 282 (wiki 'Cards' page history says 282 after 2.0.0 / The Last Divinity) | vs Trainworks VanillaCardIDs.cs (pre-DLC v1.2 game data, 231 ids): 229 matched; wiki-only 53 = 53 The Last Divinity DLC cards; id-only ['BlazingBolts2', 'BlazingBolts3'] (internal upgraded variants of Blazing Bolts, not collectible)

keyword_glossary.Action: Triggers at the start of this unit's turn.
keyword_glossary.Add: Add a card for the duration of battle.
keyword_glossary.Armor: Damage is dealt to Armor before health. Each point of Armor blocks one point of damage and is then removed.
keyword_glossary.Armored: Triggers when Armor is added to this unit.
keyword_glossary.Ascend: Move up a floor and to the back of that floor.
keyword_glossary.Attuned: Multiply the effects of Magic Power by 5.
keyword_glossary.Buffet: This unit can be eaten multiple times.
keyword_glossary.Burnout: Counts down every turn. When Burnout runs out, the unit dies.
keyword_glossary.Cardless: This unit was not summoned from a unit card. It won't go to the Consume pile upon death and can't gain Endless.
keyword_glossary.Charged Echo: Wurmkin floor resource: playing Infused cards adds Charged Echoes to the floor (4 slots per floor; excess removed at end of turn); spent/checked by Extract, Reap, Inspire, Shell/Hatch.
keyword_glossary.Consume: Can only be played once per battle.
keyword_glossary.Cultivate: Increase the attack and health of the friendly unit with the lowest health by the Cultivate value.
keyword_glossary.Damage Shield: Nullify the next source of damage.
keyword_glossary.Dazed: As long as a unit is Dazed, it can't attack or use any Action or Resolve abilities.
keyword_glossary.Descend: Move down a floor and to the back of that floor.
keyword_glossary.Eaten: After the next round of combat, this unit will be eaten by the front unit without an Eaten ability.
keyword_glossary.Emberdrain: At the start of turn, you lose 1 Ember for every stack of Emberdrain. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Enchant: Other friendly units on the same floor gain a bonus.
keyword_glossary.Endless: When this unit dies, return its card to the top of the draw pile.
keyword_glossary.Etch: Triggers when a card is Consumed on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Extract: Lose Charged Echo after you play this card. If you cannot, the card cannot be played.
keyword_glossary.Fragile: If this unit loses health, it dies.
keyword_glossary.Frostbite: Unit takes 1 damage per stack at the end of turn. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Frozen: A Frozen card is not discarded at end of turn. Frozen is removed when the card is played.
keyword_glossary.Fuel: Negates the effect of Inert. Loses 1 stack every turn.
keyword_glossary.Gorge: Triggers when this unit eats a Morsel unit.
keyword_glossary.Harvest: Triggers when a unit on this floor dies.
keyword_glossary.Haste: Moves directly from the first floor to the third floor.
keyword_glossary.Hatch: Once all Shell is removed, the unit dies, triggering its Hatch ability. Apply the Egg unit's upgrades and stat changes to the summoned unit.
keyword_glossary.Heartless: A unit with Heartless cannot be healed.
keyword_glossary.Hellborne Harvest: Triggers when one of your units dies on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Hunger: Triggers when a unit with Eaten is summoned.
keyword_glossary.Immobile: Can't move between floors or change position on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Incant: Triggers when you cast a spell on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Inert: This unit cannot attack unless it has Fuel.
keyword_glossary.Infused: When played, the current floor will gain 1 Charged Echo.
keyword_glossary.Inspire: Triggers when you gain Charged Echo on this floor, once per Charged Echo.
keyword_glossary.Lifesteal: When a unit with Lifesteal attacks, it restores health equal to the damage dealt.
keyword_glossary.Magic Power: Increases the amount of damage dealt and health restored by spells.
keyword_glossary.Melee Weakness: The next time the unit is attacked, it takes that much damage again for each stack of Melee Weakness.
keyword_glossary.Multistrike: Attacks an additional time each turn.
keyword_glossary.Offering: If discarded before the end of your turn, it will instead be played.
keyword_glossary.Phased: Cannot attack. Cannot be damaged or targeted in any way.
keyword_glossary.Piercing: Damage dealt by this card ignores armor and shield.
keyword_glossary.Purge: Once played, this card is removed from your deck for the rest of the run.
keyword_glossary.Purify: Removes all damaging debuffs from this unit at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Pyrebound: Can only be played in the Pyre Room and the floor below it.
keyword_glossary.Quick: Attacks before enemy units during combat.
keyword_glossary.Rage: +2 Attack per stack. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Rally: Triggers when you play a non-Morsel unit card on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Reap: Unit takes 1 damage per stack of Charged Echo after combat ends. Does not decrease.
keyword_glossary.Recover: Restore health to friendly units after combat.
keyword_glossary.Reform: Return a defeated friendly unit to your hand. Enhance with Burnout 1, +5 Attack, +5 Health, and 0 Ember.
keyword_glossary.Regen: Restores 1 health per stack at the end of turn. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Rejuvenate: Triggers when healed, even at full health.
keyword_glossary.Relentless: Combat in this room continues until all enemies are defeated. This unit cannot be Rooted.
keyword_glossary.Reserve: Triggers if this card remains in hand at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Rooted: Prevents the next time a unit would move between floors. Bosses are immune.
keyword_glossary.Sacrifice: Kill a friendly unit (of the required type in order) to play this card.
keyword_glossary.Sap: -2 Attack per stack. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Shell: At end of turn, remove Charged Echo from the floor to remove Shell from the front unit with Shell. When all Shell is removed, the unit will Hatch.
keyword_glossary.Slay: Triggers after dealing a killing blow.
keyword_glossary.Soul: Modifies the damage of Devourer of Death's Extinguish ability.
keyword_glossary.Spell Weakness: The next time the unit is hit by a damage spell, it takes that much damage again for each stack of Spell Weakness.
keyword_glossary.Spellchain: When played, a copy of this card will be added to hand. The copy costs +1 Ember and gains Purge.
keyword_glossary.Spikes: When a unit with Spikes is attacked, the attacker takes 1 damage per stack.
keyword_glossary.Stealth: Not a target in combat. Loses 1 stack every turn.
keyword_glossary.Trample: When attacking, excess damage is applied to the subsequent enemy unit.
keyword_glossary.Unpurgeable: Card cannot be purged by shops or Unstable Vortexes.
